day_title: Открыть звонок и рассказать о себе

phrases.speaker: role
phrases.description: The first thing a person says on a call, before anything else.
phrases.example: Can you hear me okay — should I turn my camera off?
phrases.image_api_prompt: a person on a video call at a desk with headphones, laptop screen glowing

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Не могли бы вы это повторить?
phrases.description: You say this when you did not catch what the other person said.
phrases.example: Sorry, could you repeat that, please? The line dropped for a second.
phrases.example_translation: Извините, не могли бы вы это повторить? На секунду пропала связь.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a man leaning towards a laptop with a puzzled expression, home office

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.description: You say this to explain why you did not answer straight away.
phrases.example: Sorry, the connection is unstable — give me one second.
phrases.example_translation: Извините, связь нестабильная — дайте мне секунду.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a laptop screen showing a frozen video call, close-up, no text

phrases.frame: Tell us a bit about yourself.
phrases.speaker: role
phrases.transliteration: тэл ас э бит эбаут ёсэлф
phrases.description: The interviewer opens with this, and expects about a minute.
phrases.example: Tell us a bit about yourself, and then we will move on.
phrases.example_translation: Расскажите немного о себе, а потом двинемся дальше.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a woman listening attentively during a video interview, office background

phrases.frame: I've been working with ___ for four years.
phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Я работаю с очередями задач уже четыре года.
phrases.transliteration: айв бин уоркинг уиз къюз фо фо йиэз
phrases.description: You say this to give the length of your experience with one thing.
phrases.example: I've been working with queues for four years, on big systems.
phrases.example_translation: Я работаю с очередями задач уже четыре года, в больших системах.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a developer at a desk with two monitors showing plain colored blocks, no text

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Основным моим направлением была серверная разработка.
phrases.transliteration: май мэйн фоукас уоз сёрвэр-сайд дэвэлопмент
phrases.description: You say this to name the one thing you spent most of your time on.
phrases.example: My main focus was server-side development, not the interface.
phrases.example_translation: Основным моим направлением была серверная разработка, а не интерфейс.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a server rack in a quiet room, soft light, no text or labels

phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Я каждый день разбираюсь с модулем оплаты.
phrases.transliteration: ай дил уиз зэ пэймент модьюл эври дэй
phrases.description: You say this to name the part of a product you own, day in day out.
phrases.example: I deal with the payment module every day, together with one colleague.
phrases.example_translation: Я каждый день разбираюсь с модулем оплаты, вместе с одним коллегой.
phrases.image_api_prompt: a bank card lying beside an open laptop on a desk, close-up

phrases.frame: I like teams that take a look at ___ together.
phrases.speaker: learner
phrases.translation: Мне нравятся команды, которые вместе смотрят на очереди задач.
phrases.transliteration: ай лайк тимз зэт тэйк э лук эт къюз тугэзэ
phrases.description: You say this to name the habit you want in the people you work with.
phrases.example: I like teams that take a look at queues together every Monday.
phrases.example_translation: Мне нравятся команды, которые вместе смотрят на очереди задач каждый понедельник.
phrases.image_api_prompt: two developers looking at one screen and pointing, open-plan office

words.description: The part of the work that runs on the machine, not in the browser.
words.example: My main focus was server-side development on large systems.
words.example_translation: Основным моим направлением была серверная разработка в больших системах.
words.image_api_prompt: a single server tower on a plain desk, close-up, no text

words.description: The part of a product that takes money from a customer.
words.example: My main focus was the payment module last year.
words.example_translation: Основным моим направлением был модуль оплаты в прошлом году.
words.image_api_prompt: a bank card lying next to a laptop on a desk, close-up

words.description: Not steady — it works, then it stops, then it works again.
words.example: Sorry, the connection is unstable on my side today.
words.example_translation: Извините, связь сегодня нестабильная с моей стороны.
words.image_api_prompt: a wifi router with a blinking light on a shelf, close-up

words.description: Lists of jobs a system runs one after another, not all at once.
words.example: I've been working with queues for four years, on and off.
words.example_translation: Я работаю с очередями задач уже четыре года, с перерывами.
words.image_api_prompt: a line of identical boxes moving along a conveyor belt, no text

chunks.description: To take a problem and handle it yourself until it is finished.
chunks.example: I deal with queues every day.
chunks.example_translation: Я каждый день разбираюсь с очередями задач.
chunks.image_api_prompt: two colleagues sorting papers into piles at a desk, close-up on hands

chunks.description: To spend a short moment on something before deciding about it.
chunks.example: I like teams that take a look at the payment module together.
chunks.example_translation: Мне нравятся команды, которые вместе смотрят на модуль оплаты.
chunks.image_api_prompt: a person leaning over a colleague's shoulder to look at a screen
